title: Mr. Meeseeks Box — runs
description: Telemetria dos runs do /meeseeks. Cada linha é uma invocação ponta-a-ponta (Garagem → Meeseeks → dev server).

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Uma linha por /meeseeks. Colunas começam com garagem_/meeseeks_/dev_server_ por fase. Nulls = fase não rodou.

ultimos_10_runs.title: Últimos 10 runs (resumo)
ultimos_10_runs.sql: SELECT substr(started_at, 1, 19) AS quando, terminal_phase, garagem_outcome, meeseeks_outcome, garagem_slug, ROUND(total_elapsed_s, 1) AS s, ROUND(garagem_cost_usd + COALESCE(meeseeks_cost_usd, 0), 4) AS usd FROM runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 10

custo_por_dia.title: Custo agregado por dia
custo_por_dia.sql: SELECT substr(started_at, 1, 10) AS dia, COUNT(*) AS runs, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(garagem_cost_usd, 0) + COALESCE(meeseeks_cost_usd, 0)), 4) AS usd_total, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(total_elapsed_s, 0)) / 60.0, 1) AS minutos FROM runs GROUP BY dia ORDER BY dia DESC

taxa_pushback.title: Taxa de pushback da Garagem
taxa_pushback.sql: SELECT garagem_outcome, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE garagem_outcome IS NOT NULL), 1) AS pct FROM runs WHERE garagem_outcome IS NOT NULL GROUP BY garagem_outcome

meeseeks_falhas.title: Meeseeks que falharam (pra investigar)
meeseeks_falhas.sql: SELECT substr(started_at, 1, 19) AS quando, garagem_slug, task_raw, meeseeks_branch, ROUND(meeseeks_elapsed_s, 1) AS s FROM runs WHERE meeseeks_outcome = 'failure' ORDER BY started_at DESC
